title: Gemini app gets 3.7 Flash & setting to turn off corner media watermarks
summary: When Gemini 3.7 Flash launched yesterday morning , Google said it was just powering the Spark agent in the Gemini app. Late on Thursday, 3.7 Flash replaced 3.6 Flash in the model picker across Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
